subject: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@fintrial.health>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the great discovery call yesterday. To get the pilot moving we want to lock a 60–90 minute kickoff that covers: scope and success criteria, test data and access needs, security/procurement checklist, and owner commitments for the first 4 weeks.

Suggested windows (all in PT):
- Tue Dec 7 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed Dec 8 — 14:00–15:30
- Thu Dec 9 — 09:00–10:30

Required attendees we recommend: AE (Aditya), SE (Dylan), Customer Eng lead (your team), Procurement, and Security. We can split the meeting into a technical kickoff + separate procurement/security slot if that is easier.

Attached: Kickoff-Agenda-v1.pdf (high-level agenda) and a Success-Criteria checklist.

Please reply with the best window or propose 2 alternatives. If procurement needs a later date, flag that and we can run the technical kickoff first.

Calendar draft: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-kickoff-slate
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/FT-2026-42

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@fintrial.health>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@fintrial.health>, FinTrial Procurement <procure@fintrial.health>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window

Hi Mina —

Appreciate the clear agenda. A few notes from our side:
- Our Customer Eng lead (Michael) is available Dec 8 but only after 15:00 PT because of a deployment freeze in the morning.
- Procurement is tied up until Dec 15 (budget window) and will not be able to join before then.
- Our Security team (Michael is bridging us) has a short SOC2 questionnaire; they prefer a 30-minute pre-kickoff to go over controls.

Given that, can we do a technical kickoff on Dec 8 15:30–16:30 PT with Aditya and Dylan + our Engs, and then aim to schedule procurement + security for the week of Dec 20? Alternatively, we can shift the full kickoff to Dec 21 if Redwood prefers a single session.

If you think splitting is better, let us know what you need from procurement ahead of the Dec 20–24 window.

Best,
Sarah
Director, Product Operations
FinTrial Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@fintrial.health>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window

Thanks Sarah — split plan sounds pragmatic. Quick notes on our side:
- We can run a 60-minute technical kickoff Dec 8 15:30–16:30 PT: SE covers environment access, test data, success metrics instrumentation.
- We recommend a separate 30–45 minute procurement/security sync during Dec 20–22 to close contract/regulatory items. Soojin — can you lead the security pre-brief (SOC2 Qs) the week of Dec 1–4? That would unblock procurement later.

If Sarah confirms, I will send a calendar invite for Dec 8 technical kickoff and a Doodle for the procurement/security window.

— Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@fintrial.health>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 13:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window

Happy to run the SOC2 pre-brief. I can do 30 minutes the week of Dec 1–4 (Tue/Wed morning PT preferred). For the procurement sync, we typically need: expected data retention, redaction/PII approach, and whether customer-managed keys (BYOK) are required. If FinTrial can share any procurement templates ahead of time, that will speed things up.

Suggested short pre-brief agenda:
- SOC2 scope & controls mapping (10m)
- Data handling and retention (10m)
- Next steps & doc requests (10m)

Sending a QuickPrep checklist separately.

Thanks,
Soojin
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina.h@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Bloom <sarah.bloom@fintrial.health>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, FinTrial Procurement <procure@fintrial.health>, Michael Chen <michael.chen@fintrial.health>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot start: stakeholder alignment & kickoff window

Thanks everyone — plan updated and confirmed: 
- Technical kickoff: Dec 8, 2026 — 15:30–16:30 PT (Aditya, Dylan, FinTrial Engs). Calendar invite sent.
- Security pre-brief (So, 30m): Dec 2, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 PT. Soojin to send invite and QuickPrep checklist.
- Procurement + Security sync: Dec 21, 2026 — 11:00–11:45 PT (to finalize SOW and contract items).

Action items:
- Sarah / FinTrial: share any procurement templates and the contact for contracts (if different from the proc email).
- Michael: confirm Eng attendees for Dec 8 (names + calendar invites).
- Soojin: send SOC2 pre-brief invite + QuickPrep.
- Aditya: update HubSpot FT-2026-42 with scheduled dates and upload Kickoff-Agenda-v1.pdf.

Attachments: Success-Criteria-checklist.xlsx (updated with the Dec 8 focus).

If there are any blockers, flag here and we will triage, otherwise we will proceed with the invites.

Mina
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
